updates.prepend_gate: [2026-10-16; N13 free-cross recurrence rank] The six-by-seven degree-seven forced-recurrence coefficient matrix has rank six for every cross node over every characteristic-53 extension. Explicit polynomial maximal minors satisfy U D6+V D0=1. The first-six-column determinant is 48 times an irreducible degree-37 polynomial, so the h6=lambda affine chart has no exceptional cross node in F_(53^d) when 37 does not divide d, including degrees 2,3,4. A denominator-free polynomial affine family covers all fields and the degree-37 chart exceptions. This closes only the rank-drop prerequisite; free-cross sixteen-bank existence/exclusion and full-sector/splitting conditions remain open. Parent TO RESEARCH and priority 56 unchanged.
